summary: Add a provider-neutral ecosystem/support projection with evidence-backed portfolio status, tenant-scoped onboarding and partner certification records, API/SDK/MCP/frontend surfaces and explicit external release gates.

impacts.evidence: Onboarding and partner certification records are organization/workspace scoped and read/written under forced RLS.
Evidence is digest/reference-only; tokens, private keys, raw provider payloads and production PII are rejected from the projection.
Ecosystem overview, metrics, onboarding and partner routes are additive OpenAPI contracts with generated SDK artifacts.
Onboarding and certification event payloads are versioned and contain bounded redacted evidence references.
The projection consumes connector readiness and plugin marketplace interfaces; it does not create provider branches or a second registry.
Migration 58 is additive, catalog-hashed, backup-gated by the migration framework, forced-RLS and append-only.
Authenticated permissions, SecretProvider ownership, idempotency, audit-before-write and evidence promotion gates fail closed.
Onboarding/certification writes are audited and external remote writes remain behind existing approval, capability and qualification controls.
Actor, idempotency key, bounded resource references and evidence digests are retained without sensitive payloads.
Onboarding and certification inserts are idempotent; connector, app, support and billing reconciliation remain owned by their canonical modules.
No new browser/provider transport is introduced; n8n and external connector writes remain governed public API/host paths.
Observed metrics and external gates are visible in the API/UI without converting counts into support or SLA claims.
Deprecated/revoked/blocked statuses remain visible; recovery is performed through canonical connector, app, partner and hosted controls.
Core/API/MCP/migration/contract/SDK/frontend/static gates cover the repository boundary; credentialed, hardware and production evidence remain external.
